system.description: Start of your conflict turn: your focus is one ally able to hear you, or one enemy you can see suffering dazed, enraged and/or shaken. Until your next turn, +(SL) to Checks to examine the focus and to Accuracy/Magic Checks for attacks and offensive spells that include it.
